subject: config.c: Avoid leaking file handle if file is 0 bytes (#12828)
reason: This is a resource-leak fix: rewriteConfigReadOldFile (reached only via CONFIG REWRITE) now fcloses the file handle when the config file is exactly 0 bytes instead of leaking one FILE* per call. It changes no reply, no persisted data, and no replication/failover/persistence behavior -- both builds return the same result and rewrite the same content. The leak is a single heap FILE structure per rewrite, not a crash or corruption, so liveness/ledger/deployment-state oracles cannot see it in a short run.
